verdict.rationale: Spot or interruptible pricing is a fair question for a GPU cloud, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents only On-Demand Cloud instances billed by the minute, reserved capacity on request, and 1-Click Clusters. Nothing mentions spot or preemptible instances, interruptible discounts, or preemption semantics, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can rent spot or interruptible GPU capacity at a deep discount with clearly documented preemption semantics
